mapper.update: UPDATE sector AS s JOIN ( SELECT rh2.user_id, rh2.sector_id, rh2.warehouse_id, MAX(rh2.rent_end_date) AS max_end_date FROM rent_history AS rh2 JOIN `user` AS u2 ON rh2.user_id = u2.user_id AND u2.role = '거래처' WHERE rh2.rent_end_date < NOW() GROUP BY rh2.user_id ) AS latest ON s.sector_id = latest.sector_id AND s.warehouse_id = latest.warehouse_id JOIN rent_history AS rh ON rh.user_id = latest.user_id AND rh.rent_end_date = latest.max_end_date SET s.status = '사용가능';
UPDATE user u SET u.role = '회원', u.admin_id = NULL WHERE u.role = '거래처' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rent_history rh WHERE rh.user_id = u.user_id AND rh.rent_end_date > NOW() )
